lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 13 distinct vertical white lines of varying lengths are visible on the lateral torso; spacing is tightest in the mid-section and widens toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The second line from the shoulder is abbreviated, terminating in the upper third of the torso; the final three posterior lines are fragmented into series of elongated blobs.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6 high-contrast white spots is located on the lower haunch, organized in a non-uniform density below the primary line terminators.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Three distinct circular spots on the lower mid-haunch align to form a horizontal geometric path.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white V-shaped chevron on the muzzle, a singular white transverse band on the lower neck, and white spots on the lower legs above the fetlock.
